The Anakims cut off here are the same "giants" or their descendants who frightened the fellow scouts of Joshua some forty years before. (Num. 13.) On that occasion the report was "And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight." (Num. 13:33.) Deuteronomy 2:10-11 also refers to the Anakims as "great, and many, and tall . . . giants." Note here that the Anakims of Gath were not conquered (v. 22). The Bible later tells a brief but dramatic story about a giant from Gath named Goliath. (See 1 Sam. 17:20-51.)
